arguments.rationale: AMP-activated protein kinase is the entity explicitly undergoing activation.
Aglycon is the grammatical agent of the induced pathway described as proceeding via AMPK activation.

direction.rationale: Activation explicitly denotes an increase in AMPK activity.

comparison.rationale: The activation claim names no comparison group or explicit level comparison.

polarity.rationale: The title presents the activation mechanism positively, without negation or a null finding.

uncertainty.rationale: The mechanistic statement is declarative and unhedged.

statistics.rationale: The permitted title context contains no explicit statistical observation or significance interpretation.

permitted_contextual_participants.rationale: This exact phrase identifies the cellular population in which the activation mechanism is situated.

cases.overall_rationale: The frozen title supports an affirmed, asserted increase in AMPK activity caused by Aglycon in HT-29 colon cancer cells, without an explicit comparison or statistic.

arguments.rationale: Osteonectin is the gene whose expression is investigated.

direction.rationale: Expression is assessed non-directionally; the permitted sentence does not state an increase or decrease.

comparison.rationale: No comparison of expression levels occurs in the permitted context.

polarity.rationale: The investigation of expression is stated positively and is neither negated nor reported as null.

uncertainty.rationale: The completed investigation is asserted without hedging.

statistics.rationale: The permitted sentence contains no p-value, confidence interval, effect estimate, or significance interpretation.

permitted_contextual_participants.rationale: This phrase identifies the cells in which osteonectin expression was investigated.
v-Ki-ras explicitly defines the transformation state of the fibroblast population, but the sentence does not establish it as a causal regulator of osteonectin expression.

cases.overall_rationale: The permitted sentence asserts a non-directional investigation of osteonectin expression in v-Ki-ras-transformed BALB/c fibroblasts and states no result comparison or statistic.

arguments.rationale: Tumor is the entity characterized as undergoing progression.

direction.rationale: Progression is invoked as a biological context, but no quantified directional change is stated.

comparison.rationale: The context includes no explicit comparator or comparison of tumor progression.

polarity.rationale: Tumor progression is referenced affirmatively, not denied or reported as analytically absent.

uncertainty.rationale: The sentence uses an unhedged declarative description.

statistics.rationale: No explicit statistical observation or author significance interpretation is present in the permitted context.

cases.overall_rationale: The permitted review sentence treats tumor progression as an affirmed biological context, with tumor as the affected entity and no explicit comparison, statistic, or eligible additional entity participant.

arguments.rationale: EGF-R is one protein whose abundance is explicitly described as increased.

direction.rationale: The source explicitly states an increase in protein abundance.

comparison.rationale: The comparative adjective increased explicitly denotes greater abundance than its reference level, although the reference is not named.

polarity.rationale: The increased abundance is described as detected, not negated or null.

uncertainty.rationale: Detection of the abundance increase is asserted; the later modal can applies to prognostic usefulness rather than to the increase itself.

statistics.rationale: The permitted sentence gives no p-value, confidence interval, effect estimate, or explicit significance interpretation.

permitted_contextual_participants.rationale: This coordinated protein mention shares the explicitly increased-abundance predicate with EGF-R.
The phrase identifies the tumour population in which increased protein abundance is detected.

cases.overall_rationale: The frozen sentence affirms detected greater abundance of EGF-R or Her-2/neu proteins in human tumours; its prognostic usefulness is modal, but the abundance increase itself is asserted.

arguments.rationale: The glucose transporters are the entities whose expression is described as regulated.

direction.rationale: The expression is described as regulated, but the permitted context does not specify whether transporter expression rises or falls.

comparison.rationale: No comparison group or comparative transporter-expression result is stated.

polarity.rationale: The expression-regulation mechanism is positively framed, not negated or reported as a null result.

uncertainty.rationale: Within the permitted sentence, the mechanism is framed as an ability under examination rather than as a stated completed result.

statistics.rationale: The permitted context contains no explicit statistic or author significance interpretation.

permitted_contextual_participants.rationale: The sentence grammatically assigns this compound the ability to regulate transporter localization and expression.
Reduced glucose consumption is the explicit downstream outcome linked to transporter regulation by the by construction.

cases.overall_rationale: The permitted study-aim sentence links 8-aminoadenosine provisionally to non-directional regulation of glucose-transporter expression as a mechanism for reducing glucose consumption, without an expression comparison or statistic.

arguments.rationale: Vascular endothelial growth factor-C is explicitly in scope of the expression event.

direction.rationale: The title names expression and its regulation but provides no up-or-down direction for VEGF-C expression.

comparison.rationale: No explicit expression-level comparison is stated in the permitted title.

polarity.rationale: VEGF-C expression is named affirmatively, not negated or characterized as a null result.

uncertainty.rationale: The title states the regulatory scope directly without a hedge.

statistics.rationale: The permitted title contains no explicit statistic or author significance interpretation.

permitted_contextual_participants.rationale: VEGF-B is coordinated with VEGF-C under the same expression construction.
This exact phrase specifies the cancer population in which expression is considered.
The title explicitly places this gene after regulation by, assigning a regulatory role without specifying direction.
Hypoxia is the second explicit factor governed by the title's regulation by construction.

cases.overall_rationale: The frozen title asserts VEGF-B and VEGF-C expression in renal cell carcinomas as regulated by the VHL gene and hypoxia, while leaving expression direction, comparison, and statistics unstated.

arguments.rationale: Tumour is the entity explicitly subjected to inhibition.

direction.rationale: Tumour inhibition denotes a decrease in tumour activity or growth.

comparison.rationale: The permitted sentence provides no explicit comparator for the inhibition result.

polarity.rationale: The studies are said to show activity against the tumours, affirming rather than negating inhibition.

uncertainty.rationale: Showed is an assertive result formulation without hedging.

statistics.rationale: No explicit statistic or significance interpretation appears in the permitted sentence.

permitted_contextual_participants.rationale: STX243 is explicitly described as active against the resistant tumours and is therefore the inhibitory agent.

arguments.rationale: CDC4 is the explicit object whose role was assessed; the methods sentence does not establish a causal effect.
Gastric cancer supplies the disease context for the role assessment without being stated as an outcome caused by CDC4.

direction.rationale: A role assessment does not state an increase, decrease, association result, enabling relation, or observed directional effect.

comparison.rationale: The methods statement contains no comparative result.

polarity.rationale: The assessment itself is positively asserted and is neither negated nor a null result.

uncertainty.rationale: The permitted METHODS context identifies a role under assessment but supplies no result establishing that role.

statistics.rationale: The sample count is not an effect estimate, and the permitted methods sentence states no p-value, confidence interval, or significance interpretation.

cases.overall_rationale: The frozen METHODS sentence affirms that CDC4's role in gastric cancer was assessed but does not establish a directional, comparative, causal, or statistical result; LOH and MLPA are methods and were not added as participants.
